item.title: Prework
item.description: Welcome to the Introducing Yourself Online workshop! We look forward to meeting you. Before attending the workshop, please complete the following prework. Set up RStudio Cloud Sign up for a free RStudio Cloud account at https://rstudio.cloud/ before the workshop. I recommend logging in with an existing Google or GitHub account, if you have one (rather than creating a new account with another password you have to remember).

item.title: A postcard
item.description: Pre-requisites First, make sure you have the latest version of the postcards package installed from CRAN: install.packages("postcards") Restart your R session. item.title: Technology sucks!
item.description: Just Imagine your everyday life without your phone, your Facebook home page, or your instagram feed. Imagine that you don’t have to respond to that annoyingly attractive notification sound. Imagine you can have a conversation with someone without them staring at a screen in the middle of talking. For a some time I have been, as most of you, if not all, a slave to my phone. This year, I had to write my thesis, a job that is mentally demanding and exhausting, and for some time, I couldn’t focus enough to get anything done.

item.title: The illusion of high standards
item.description: Almost everyone would say that they have high standards, in people they meet, probably in food, and sometimes in the way they do stuff. In this article I will be talking about why high standards are an illusive motto made for teens who need the entire attention of the world, and why at the end of the day, it only depends on how you perceive yourself rather than the others, and how reality will make you change your mind every time.

item.title: Contact
item.description: ** Contact page don’t contain a body, just the front matter above. See form.html in the layouts folder. Formspree requires a (free) account and new form to be set up.
